---
description: "Generated-data and accessibility rules for the interactive research explainer."
applyTo: "site/**/*.{astro,ts,tsx,css}"
---

- Import scientific values and claim status from the generated artifact bundle.
- Keep the paper title and primary research result visible in the first viewport.
- Provide semantic text or table fallbacks for every chart and interaction.
- Treat the site as a research explainer, not a marketing landing page.
- Preserve keyboard access, reduced-motion behavior, responsive dimensions, and readable labels.
